name: defaultContent
description: If `true`, use the default content for the footer.

name: defaultContentBaseURL
description: Set the base URL for the `defaultContent` links. Do not include a trailing slash.

params.name: enabled
params.description: If `true`, show the theme selector in the footer.

params.name: currentTheme
params.description: The current theme which has been selected. Options are `system`, `light` and `dark`.

params.name: title
params.description: The visually hidden title for the theme selector, used for accessibility.

params.name: system
params.description: Settings for the system theme.

params.name: label
params.description: The label for the system theme option.

params.name: title
params.description: The title for the system theme option.
params.default: Change to using the system theme

params.name: light
params.description: Settings for the light theme.

params.name: label
params.description: The label for the light theme option.

params.name: title
params.description: The title for the light theme option.
params.default: Change to using the light theme

params.name: dark
params.description: Settings for the dark theme.

params.name: label
params.description: The label for the dark theme option.

params.name: title
params.description: The title for the dark theme option.
params.default: Change to using the dark theme

name: meta
description: An optional piece of text to display in the footer between the address and social media icons.

name: social
description: An optional object of social media.

params.name: title
params.description: The title of the social media section.

params.name: ariaLabel
params.description: An optional ARIA label for the social media section.

params.name: items
params.description: A list of social media items.

params.name: href
params.description: The URL for the social media link.

params.name: icon
params.description: An icon to use for the social media link. Options are `twitter`, `youtube`, `facebook`, `flickr`, `instagram`, `rss` and `github`.

params.name: title
params.description: A title to use for the social media link.

params.name: shortTitle
params.description: A shorter title to display next to the social media icon. If not specified, the full title will be used.

name: navigation
description: An optional list of navigation sections to display in the main body of the footer.

params.name: title
params.description: The title of the navigation section.

params.name: hideTitle
params.description: If `true`, hide the title of the navigation section.

params.name: items
params.description: A list of items in the navigation section.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to display for the navigation item.

params.name: href
params.description: The URL of the navigation item.

params.name: title
params.description: An optional title for the navigation item, used for accessibility.

params.name: newTab
params.description: If `true`, open the link in a new tab.

name: legal
description: A list of 'legal' links to display in the footer such as the cookie page, accessibility statement, privacy notice and terms and conditions.

params.name: text
params.description: The text of the legal link item.

params.name: href
params.description: The URL of the legal link item.

params.name: title
params.description: An optional title for the item, used for accessibility.

name: cookiesUrl
description: The URL of the cookie preferences page for the service. Required if the theme selector is enabled.

name: openInNewTabText
description: The text to display for the 'open in new tab' option for footer links.

name: newsletter
description: Configuration options for the newsletter section of the footer.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Indicates whether the newsletter section is enabled.

params.name: title
params.description: The title of the newsletter section.

params.name: text
params.description: The text of the newsletter section.
params.default: Hear about our latest news, stories from the collection and priority booking for events.

params.name: button
params.description: Configuration options for the newsletter button.

params.name: text
params.description: The text of the newsletter button.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL to which the newsletter form should submit.

params.name: title
params.description: The title attribute for the newsletter button.
params.default: Subscribe to the National Archives newsletter

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the footer.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the footer.
